HTTP/1.1 over a 0600 unix socket, JSON
the whole parent contract: read state, commit one action, ask for what the store cannot do

span.p:
reads ControlState · commits through exactly one setter · requestRun
the mirror is the store itself; nothing is computed for the wire

the parts above the store, answered by the layer that owns the store
